verdict.rationale: The evidence pack shows no Outlook feature that uses AI to auto-label, categorize, or surface important mail with steerable, auditable behavior. Microsoft Graph categories, inbox rules, and query parameters are developer building blocks or rule-based controls, not AI triage. The single Copilot mention says nothing about triage.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, AI triages my inbox for me — auto-labeling, categorizing, and surfacing what needs attention — with behavior I can steer and audit
